newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day Cetes rate eases decline at close.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day Cetes rate eases decline at close.

text.p: Mexico's same-day Cetes rates moderated their earlier declines to close down 10 basis points at 23.0 percent on speculation, dealers said.
"It is almost the end of the month and the majority of the people are looking for paper," said one dealer.
"But at the end of the day people who were holding on to their paper had to sell to cover their positions," said one dealer.
Dealers said activity was weak, but longer-term paper was on offer by foreign investors. The 28-day government paper closed at 24.25 percent, while 91-day paper closed at 28.25 percent.
Bank notes and acceptances, including pagares, closed down 11 basis points at 24.64 percent.
During the trading session the central bank injected credits worth 4.105 billion pesos through three auctions.
Maturing credits for Thursday are seen at about 3.0 billion pesos.
Dealers said rates could be slightly pressured by demand for month-end paper.
